commands:
for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -m multiport --dports ssh -j f2b-o-a-iptables-multiport
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-o-a-iptables-multiport
<iptables> -X f2b-o-a-iptables-multiport

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -m multiport --dports ssh -j f2b-o-a-iptables-multiport
done; done

files.jail.local:
[o-a-iptables-multiport]
enabled = true
filter =
logpath = /dev/null
backend = polling
action = iptables-multiport

stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING No filter set for jail o-a-iptables-multiport
